column8: e.g. GO:0044255 - exactly what the obo source stores in identifier.  The filter is not cosmetic: OBO ontologies give oboinowl:id to OWL object and annotation properties as well as to classes, so a full GO extract yields 11 rows whose "identifier" is a relationship name - part_of, occurs_in, regulates, ends_during, happens_during, starts_during, has_part, positively_regulates, negatively_regulates, has_ontology_root_term, term_tracker_item. They loaded as GOTerms and sorted to the top of the class in the UI.  Requiring the PREFIX:digits shape keeps every real term (GO:, HP:, MP:, UBERON:) and drops these; the column is required=yes, so a failing row is dropped rather than blanked.
IAO_0000115 = "definition"; obo source stores the def in description

column8: Exactly what stock HumanMine loads: OboParser reads `xref`, and OboConverter.createXref builds an OntologyTerm with that identifier and adds it to crossReferences.  The collection holds OntologyTerm, not CrossReference, so xref ids like Reactome:REACT_28392 become identifier-only OntologyTerms - that is the stock behaviour this replaces, not a side effect.
obo source stores each synonym with its scope in OntologyTermSynonym.type

spec D2 - still open, but narrower than it looks: OboParser never reads `subset`, so stock HumanMine has never loaded GO-slim membership and dropping this changes nothing.  The only real question is whether to go *beyond* stock by extending the model.

is_a parents (obo source fills OntologyTerm.parents).  The filter runs on the raw term, before the transform, and is not optional: in OWL, rdfs:subClassOf also points at anonymous class expressions (owl:Restriction, "part_of some X").  A full GO extract returns 92,208 superclass rows of which 16,178 are blank nodes and 3 are owl:Thing; without the filter iri_localname turned each blank node into a GOTerm whose identifier was its node id, adding 16k junk parents.  Restricting to the OBO namespace keeps legitimate cross-ontology parents (BFO, CARO), which still arrive as identifier-only stub items - filter harder if unwanted.
oboinowl:id carries the identifier; the IRI is redundant
